literature_basis.summary: Aso et al. 2014 reported avoidance-associated glutamatergic MBON activation and attraction-associated GABAergic/cholinergic MBON activation, with dopamine-dependent KC-MBON depression proposed to shift the MBON ensemble balance.

interpretation_boundary: The game reward-to-valence-channel mapping is a project-defined model interface. This configuration does not claim that FightingICE reward is an endogenous DAN signal or that MBON valence is context independent.
